record_kind: Internally timestamped, locked follow-up subgroup analysis. Global primary FAIL is known. No subgroup performance has been examined. Not an externally registered confirmatory trial.
known_global_results: User-reported Abell Enformer risk-vs-magnitude gain -0.021 CI95[-0.036,-0.007]; Ulirsch -0.003 CI95[-0.065,0.067]. Original FAIL cannot be reversed by any subgroup.
AlphaGenome: Excluded from input loading, training, fitting and statistics. No AlphaGenome dependency or permission flag exists in this package.
inputs: Existing v2 variants.csv, both complete eight-shard journals/state files, frozen track metadata, original external_predictions.csv and audit_summary.json. All original files are read-only.
source_diagnostics: Kircher grouped leave-one-family-out risk fitting; no held-out family labels in fit, source scaling or probability calibration. Source results descriptive, not part of formal external hypothesis tests.
Enformer_external_policy: Reuse risk_raw from original external_predictions.csv after exact population and frozen-forecast checks; no retraining or reranking changes.
Borzoi_external_policy: New CPU source-only fit with same fixed 14-fit/5-calibration Kircher family split and 17-feature architecture, own-model magnitude/dispersion and Enformer as the other model. No tuning.

fixed_estimator.calibration: Source-only isotonic, ranking uses raw classifier risk
fixed_estimator.source_split: Ascending SHA256(20261012+family); first ceil(.25*n) calibrate; held-out Kircher family removed before split

subgroup_definitions.regulatory_type: Primary uniform annotation across all studies: overlap with ENCODE3 hg38 cCRE PLS=promoter-like, pELS/dELS=enhancer-like. Other/unannotated remain reported, not relabeled enhancer. PLS+ELS overlap is ambiguous and excluded from this two-level contrast. These are genomic signatures, not experimentally established reporter construct types.
subgroup_definitions.effect_strength: Strong audit views have |screen effect|>=1.0 log2; weak active audit views have0.5<=|screen effect|<1.0. <0.5 is a separate negligible/noisy descriptive category. External screening and sign truth use disjoint replicate samples exactly as v2. A variant can contribute eligible views to both bins; each bin averages its views once per variant and bootstrap preserves clusters. Never select or rerank within measured-effect groups.
subgroup_definitions.model: Frozen DNASE forecasts Enformer vs Borzoi. DNASE only is inferential; no best-of-modality choice. All other modalities are descriptive from existing outputs.
subgroup_definitions.cell_match: For each model, all actual selected DNASE track descriptions must match the declared assay cell with strict, prespecified aliases. Any tissue/other-cell/mouse-cell human-track proxy is unmatched. Missing identity is unknown. No artificial mismatched-cell scores are generated. An absent external unmatched stratum is NOT ESTIMABLE.

retention.global: Exactly floor(.25*n) per original dataset/1Mb block for each model/policy; then stratify. Subgroup selected counts need not match and are displayed. Audited sign counts differ from total retained counts.
retention.metadata_sensitivity: For regulatory type and cell-match only, reselect at floor(.25*n) within block and metadata stratum using frozen scores. Exact within-stratum budgets. Effect-strength groups are never selection strata.

sign_target: External v2 replicate-separated sign error averaged over qualifying views per variant; Kircher published source coefficient sign, with missing replicate noise acknowledged.

formal_test_family.model_contrasts: Borzoi-Enformer point Pearson difference, Enformer-Borzoi all-retention sign-error difference, Borzoi-Enformer confidence-filtering gain difference

multiplicity: Two-sided null-centered paired cluster-bootstrap tests, approximate conditional inference. Holm FWER0.05 across all70 slots, including non-estimable slots as p=1. Report pointwise95% and conservative Bonferroni70-test family intervals. No selective removal of null tests; no crossing subgroups or data-dependent cutoffs.
evaluability: Each gain needs>=20 audited variants per policy and>=10 blocks with audit calls for both. Model contrasts require>=20 paired evaluable variants and>=10 contributing blocks. Missing stratum/correlation/unstable bootstrap is NOT ESTIMABLE, not zero-effect evidence.
bootstrap: Resample 1Mb genomic blocks as paired units separately within each external study. Kircher source diagnostics resample whole family. Conditional on frozen policies; no claim of exact finite-sample coverage or proven LD independence.
noise_ceiling: Primary-eligible variants, all measured effect sizes; R=1-mean(SEM²)/Var(mean effect), Pearson ceiling=sqrt(R). Abell SEM²=Var(3 paired effects)/3; Ulirsch=Var(6 RNA log ratios)/6+Var(2 DNA log ratios)/2. Bootstrap re-estimates R and corrected Pearson. R<=0 is unidentified; corrected |r|>1 is unstable, never clipped. No Spearman ceiling correction. Kircher full ceiling unavailable because most per-variant replicate estimates are absent. LDLR/SORT1 separate library agreement descriptive only.
interpretation: No subgroup result rescues original FAIL. Harm requires Holm<.05 and negative gain; benefit requires Holm<.05 and positive gain plus>=90% baseline audited opportunities. Dataset-specific discoveries require independent replication. Lack of significance is not equivalence. Original Ulirsch interval permits substantial gains and losses.
conference: GLBIO2027 full-paper track; January7,2027 23:59AoE, official OUP Bioinformatics Advances template, <=9pages inclusive; separate journal publication review after conference acceptance.
